confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Vienna prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are the more reliable ones; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain and reflect July high-season demand. Cocktail is estimated from the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open the page itself to confirm the figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Munich and other western European and German-speaking capitals with similar restaurant and hotel price levels, adjusted to Vienna's Austrian cost profile.
